apiKey.title: Odds-API.io API key
apiKey.description: Your Odds-API.io API key. Get one at https://odds-api.io/pricing

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to fetch: events (fixtures and scores), odds (prices per bookmaker and market) or valueBets (prices above a fair-odds estimate).

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Sport slug, for example football, basketball, tennis, esports.

league.title: League
league.description: Optional league slug, for example england-premier-league.

bookmakers.title: Bookmakers
bookmakers.description: Comma-separated bookmaker names, for example Bet365,Unibet. Required for odds and valueBets modes. Must be bookmakers selected on your plan.

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Optional comma-separated market names for odds mode, for example ML,Spread,Totals.

eventIds.title: Event IDs
eventIds.description: Optional event IDs. When set, events and odds modes fetch these events instead of listing by sport and league.

status.title: Event status
status.description: Status filter when listing events: pending, live, settled, cancelled, or a comma-separated list.

maxEvents.title: Max events
maxEvents.description: Maximum number of events to list in events and odds modes.
